test_pause_resume: test the AsyncLLM engine pause and resume functionality with keep mode to verify generation stops during pause
create_engine_async_llm: create an AsyncLLM engine instance from AsyncEngineArgs with a specified model and eager mode
run_generate_with_params: run async text generation on the engine using a prompt and SamplingParams with max_tokens and ignore_eos
pause_generation_keep: pause the AsyncLLM engine generation in keep mode to stop token output temporarily
resume_generation: resume the paused AsyncLLM engine generation to continue producing tokens
